tasks.label: Colcon Build
tasks.detail: Build the workspace, or only the given packages and their dependencies

tasks.label: Colcon Clean
tasks.detail: Clean the workspace, or only the given packages
tasks.command: pkgs='${input:packages}'; if [ -n "$pkgs" ]; then colcon clean packages --yes --packages-select $pkgs; else colcon clean workspace --yes; fi

inputs.description: Packages, separated by spaces (leave empty for all)
